requests.reply: {"translations": ["At dawn, the mist outside the mountain gate hadn't dissipated.", "Yunzhou, you finally came back. Did you bring enough of the spirit stones?""]}
{"translations": ["Brought three bags, they are all the best from the back mountain."]}
{"translations": ["The barrier cracked again last night, and Elder Qin didn't sleep a wink."]}
{"translations": ["The voice hadn't fallen, Wan Yi Ting Jing rushed up from below."] , "He gasped and said, 'There was a young woman lying on the side of the road at the foot of the mountain.'"]}
{"translations": ["Please lift it up. If water, go and fetch the medicine for treating injuries."]}
{"translations": ["Wansita Jing dashed into the main hall with the unconscious woman, and the iron badge on his waist was engraved with: Chu Shuang."]}
{"translations": ["The injury is not serious, just exhausted the spiritual power. Feed one Return Spirit Pill."]}
{"translations": ["Sister Zang, Elder Qin called you to the barrier side, here are I and Brother Shi Wan Si."] , ["Okay. Miss Chou is awake, immediately come and call me."]}
{"translations": ["Wan Sita Jing scratched his head and turned to run towards the foot of the mountain."]}
{"translations": ["He stood at the entrance to the hall, his sword hadn't been drawn, but the lights flickered for a moment."]}
{"translations": ["Elder Qin, how have you been? I have come at the order of the Pavilion Master to collect three shares of spirit stones."]}

{"translations": ["Three-tenths? The spirit stones were accumulated by the sect through hard work, when should outsiders come to take them?","The barriers have all broken, the spirit stones are not safe if you hold them. In three days, I will return."] }
{"translations": ["He sneered coldly, turned around, and walked away without looking back."]}
{"translations": ["Saying something three days in a row is exactly what it is, and never breaks promises."]}
{"translations": ["Elder Qin stroked his beard and looked at the unconscious Chou Shuang on the mat."]}
{"translations": ["Elder, let me go guard the barrier. Chou Gu'er has Luo Chu taking care of her, I can leave."] , "Finally, nodded, took out a jade token from his sleeve."]}
{"translations": ["This is the Nexus Decree. Holding onto it is what secures your path."]}
{"translations": ["Lechuan put the medicine pouch into Yunzhou's arms, and then quietly reminded him of a few more things."]}

{"translations": ["Dan Yunzhou nodded and tucked the formation eye command close to his body."]}
{"translations": ["Inside the hall, Chou Shuang slowly opened her eyes."]}
{"translations": ["You're awake, that's all that matters. You've been confused all day, don't move around randomly."]}

translations.12: Wan Sita Jing scratched his head and turned to run towards the foot of the mountain.
translations.13: He stood at the entrance to the hall, his sword hadn't been drawn, but the lights flickered for a moment.
translations.14: Elder Qin, how have you been? I have come at the order of the Pavilion Master to collect three shares of spirit stones.
translations.15: Three-tenths? The spirit stones were accumulated by the sect through hard work, when should outsiders come to take them?
translations.16: The barriers have all broken, the spirit stones are not safe if you hold them. In three days, I will return.
translations.17: He sneered coldly, turned around, and walked away without looking back.
translations.18: Saying something three days in a row is exactly what it is, and never breaks promises.
translations.19: Elder Qin stroked his beard and looked at the unconscious Chou Shuang on the mat.
translations.22: This is the Nexus Decree. Holding onto it is what secures your path.
translations.23: Lechuan put the medicine pouch into Yunzhou's arms, and then quietly reminded him of a few more things.
translations.24: At the foot of the mountain, Wan Sita Jing delivered a蓑衣 (sǎo yī - raincoat).
translations.25: Thank you, Senior Wan Sita.  You should tell Miss You to thank her.
translations.26: Dan Yunzhou nodded and tucked the formation eye command close to his body.
translations.27: Inside the hall, Chou Shuang slowly opened her eyes.
translations.28: You're awake, that's all that matters. You've been confused all day, don't move around randomly.
translations.29: Chou Shuang struggled to sit up, looking out at the torn curtain of sky.
translations.3: Brought three bags, they are all the best from the back mountain.
translations.30: No one noticed, the letter in his sleeve was sealed with the seal of Xie Xuan.
translations.4: The barrier cracked again last night, and Elder Qin didn't sleep a wink.
